title: Diagnostics Inspector — Error Classification Lens and Payload Drilldown
creator: Sophie Chen
description: Problem: On the Redwood Console users currently struggle to triage intermittent failed requests and cascading retries. The existing 'request detail' view surfaces raw logs but lacks a clear error taxonomy, visual aggregation of retry chains, or a safe guided payload inspector for PII-sensitive fields. Goals: 1) Surface an error-classification lens that summarizes error types (network, model-decoding, quota, validation) with counts and time series context; 2) Provide a retry-chain visualization that groups attempts, shows latency deltas and model/variant used on each attempt; 3) Add a payload drilldown that shows sanitized request/response snapshots and allows side-by-side diffing between attempts; 4) Ensure the UX supports rapid hypothesis testing and safe sharing with support teams.
acceptance_criteria: Error Classification header shows top 5 error buckets with counts and sparkline for the selected time range
Retry Chain timeline groups attempts and exposes per-attempt metadata (model, variant, region, latency, token delta)
Payload Drilldown shows sanitized JSON view with toggle for full vs redacted content and ability to compare two attempts side-by-side
Edge cases handled: truncated payloads, streaming partials, malformed responses — UI renders meaningful placeholder and copy for each
Design artifacts (Figma), prototype, and handoff notes delivered to Eng with accessibility checks and token-level telemetry hooks defined
design_decisions: Use taxonomy-first approach: compute buckets server-side and surface labels rather than being rule-based in UI
Represent retry chains as a horizontal swimlane with attempt cards to allow quick scanning and expansion
Default payload view to redacted mode; explicit user toggle to reveal full content for engineers with permission
Provide lightweight 'share snapshot' token that expires and omits sensitive fields for support collaboration
tech_dependencies: runtime: include attempt metadata (variant, region, attempt_id) in request trace payload
console-api: endpoint for precomputed error buckets and sanitized snapshot generation
auth: ticket-scoped share-tokens and permission gating for payload reveal
user_research_notes: Prototype tested with 6 internal engineers and 3 external beta customers — average time-to-identify root cause reduced from 12m to 4m in task scenario
Common pain point: noisy logs make it hard to see which attempt changed model variant — we surface variant on attempt cards
Support asked for ephemeral share links and an 'export for compliance' mode that redacts user PII
